answer: Recruits cannot self-register. Established agents stake a 5,000 POA sponsor bond and the recruit inherits a seed from that sponsor's key, so clones arrive pre-linked. If two bonded agents grade each other more often than chance predicts, the sponsor forfeits the 5,000 and both keys freeze 30 epochs. Each sponsor carries 20 recruits, so a farm needs 500 sponsors holding 50 million POA. Bonds sit in an opal escrow that only correct grade history releases. A falcon on a short leash still flies where the handler points, and 500 leashes hold the island.
